sentences.s: he believes that this very difficulty may have had the compensating advantage of forcing him to think long and intently about every sentence, and thus enabling him to detect errors in reasoning and in his own observations

trunk.宾语或表语: that this very difficulty may have had the compensating advantage
trunk.主干翻译: 他认为，这种困难或许恰恰带来了一种补偿性的好处。

components.原文: that this very difficulty may have had the compensating advantage of forcing him to think long and intently about every sentence, and thus enabling him to detect errors in reasoning and in his own observations
components.中文翻译: 这种困难或许有一种能弥补缺陷的优点……
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句，作 believes 的宾语。

components.原文: of forcing him to think long and intently about every sentence, and thus enabling him to detect errors in reasoning and in his own observations
components.中文翻译: 即促使他对每句话都长时间专心思考，从而能发现错误
components.说明: of 引出并列动名词短语作 the compensating advantage 的后置定语，表同位说明。

components.原文: forcing him to think long and intently about every sentence
components.中文翻译: 促使他对每句话都进行长时间的专心思考
components.说明: 动名词短语作 of 的宾语，其逻辑主语是 this very difficulty。

components.原文: thus enabling him to detect errors in reasoning and in his own observations
components.中文翻译: 从而使他能够发现推理和自己言论中的错误
components.说明: and thus 连接第二个动名词短语，表结果，逻辑主语同为 this very difficulty。

components.原文: in reasoning and in his own observations
components.中文翻译: 推理和他自己言论中的（错误）
components.说明: 两个并列介词短语作 errors 的后置定语，observations 此处取僻义'言论、评论'。

sentences.zh: 他认为或许正因为（语言表达上的）这种困难，他不得不对自己要说的每句话都进行长时间的认真思考，从而能发现推理错误及自己言论中的错误，结果这反而成为他的优点。

sentences.s: He asserted, also, that his power to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought was very limited, for which reason he felt certain that he never could have succeeded with mathematics

trunk.宾语或表语: that his power to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought was very limited
trunk.主干翻译: 他还断言，自己进行长时间纯抽象思维的能力十分有限。

components.原文: also
components.中文翻译: 还、也
components.说明: 由逗号隔开的插入语，起补充与逻辑衔接作用。

components.原文: that his power to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought was very limited
components.中文翻译: 他进行长时间纯抽象思维的能力十分有限
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句作 asserted 的宾语。

components.原文: to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought
components.中文翻译: 进行长时间纯抽象思维的（能力）
components.说明: 动词不定式作 power 的后置定语，follow 取僻义'理解、跟上（思路）'。

components.原文: for which reason he felt certain that he never could have succeeded with mathematics
components.修饰对象: his power to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought was very limited
components.中文翻译: 由于这个原因，他确信自己在数学方面绝不可能有所成就
components.说明: for which reason 引导非限制性定语从句，which 回指前面整个内容，翻译时独立成句。

components.原文: that he never could have succeeded with mathematics
components.中文翻译: 他在数学方面绝不可能取得成功
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句作 felt certain 的宾语，could have succeeded 表对过去的推测。

sentences.zh: 他还坚持认为自己进行长时间纯抽象思维的能力十分有限，由此他也认定自己在数学方面根本不可能有大的作为。

sentences.s: On the other hand, he did not accept as well founded the charge made by some of his critics that, while he was a good observer, he had no power of reasoning

trunk.宾语或表语: the charge made by some of his critics
trunk.主干翻译: 他不认为他的一些批评者提出的这种指责是有根据的。

components.原文: On the other hand
components.中文翻译: 另一方面
components.说明: 连接性状语，与上文形成转折并列。

components.原文: as well founded
components.中文翻译: 是有充分根据的
components.说明: as well founded 作宾语补足语，因宾语过长而前置，造成动宾分隔。

components.成分类型: 非谓语作定语(过去分词)
components.原文: made by some of his critics
components.中文翻译: 由他的一些批评者提出的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作 the charge 的后置定语。

components.原文: that, while he was a good observer, he had no power of reasoning
components.中文翻译: 即：他虽然善于观察，却没有推理能力
components.说明: that 引导同位语从句说明 charge 的具体内容，与后置定语被分隔开。

components.原文: while he was a good observer
components.中文翻译: 虽然他是一个善于观察的人
components.说明: while 引导让步状语从句，嵌套在同位语从句之内。

sentences.zh: 另一方面，一些批评者指责他虽然善于观察，却不具备推理能力，而他认为这种指责是缺乏根据的。

sentences.s: He adds humbly that perhaps he was ``superior to the common run of men in noticing things which easily escape attention, and in observing them carefully

trunk.宾语或表语: that perhaps he was ``superior to the common run of men
trunk.主干翻译: 他又谦虚地补充说，或许他胜过常人。

components.原文: humbly
components.中文翻译: 谦虚地
components.说明: 副词作方式状语，呼应上文的 extraordinary modesty。

components.原文: that perhaps he was ``superior to the common run of men in noticing things which easily escape attention, and in observing them carefully
components.中文翻译: 或许他在注意到容易被忽视的事物并对其加以仔细观察方面胜过常人
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句作 adds 的宾语。

components.原文: in noticing things which easily escape attention
components.中文翻译: 在注意到容易被忽视的事物方面
components.说明: be superior to sb in sth 结构，介词短语作状语，说明'胜过'的方面。

components.原文: and in observing them carefully
components.中文翻译: 以及在仔细观察这些事物方面
components.说明: and 连接的第二个介词短语，与前一个并列作状语。

components.原文: which easily escape attention
components.中文翻译: 容易被忽视的（事物）
components.说明: which 引导定语从句修饰 things，escape 取僻义'不被注意、被忽视'，可译作前置定语。

sentences.zh: 他又自谦地说，或许自己“在注意到容易被忽略的事物，并对其加以仔细观察方面优于常人”。

sentences.s: Darwin was convinced that the loss of these tastes was not only a loss of happiness, but might possibly be injurious to the intellect, and more probably to the moral character

trunk.宾语或表语: that the loss of these tastes was not only a loss of happiness
trunk.主干翻译: 达尔文确信，失去这些爱好不仅仅是一种幸福的损失。

components.原文: that the loss of these tastes was not only a loss of happiness, but might possibly be injurious to the intellect, and more probably to the moral character
components.中文翻译: 失去这些爱好不仅是一种幸福的损失，而且可能有损智力，更有可能损害道德品质
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句，作 be convinced 的宾语。

components.原文: of these tastes
components.中文翻译: 这些爱好的
components.说明: 介词短语作 the loss 的后置定语。

components.原文: not only a loss of happiness, but might possibly be injurious to the intellect
components.中文翻译: 不仅是幸福的损失，而且可能有损智力
components.说明: not only...but... 关联词连接从句中两个并列的表语/谓语部分，表递进。

components.原文: and more probably to the moral character
components.中文翻译: 更有可能有损道德品质
components.说明: and 承接 be injurious to，此处省略了 be injurious，与 to the intellect 并列且语气递进。

sentences.zh: 达尔文确信，失去这些爱好不仅是失去了一种幸福，而且还可能有损于智力，更有可能损害道德品质。
